name: folder
title: Folder
description: A manila file folder that is also a set of tabs: a row of paper tabs standing on a sheet of the same paper. The active tab is the folder's own color and runs down into the body, so tab and folder are one piece; the others stand a little lower and darker. It is Reka UI Tabs underneath.

a11y: Reka UI Tabs gives the whole pattern: `tablist` / `tab` / `tabpanel` roles, `aria-selected`, `aria-controls`, roving focus with arrow keys, Home and End (Left and Right swap in RTL), and a disabled tab skipped by the keyboard.

The drawn tab paper, the crease and the shadows are aria-hidden. The active tab is also `aria-selected` and bold, so it never depends on color alone. Tab text is ink: 9:1 on the manila, 7.5:1 on a tab standing behind it.

Windows high contrast replaces the drawn tabs with bordered buttons (the tabs carry a real border until their drawing exists and in forced colors), and the active tab fills with the system highlight color. The open panel is a tab stop and shows the standard focus ring.
meta.usage:
import { Folder, FolderContent, FolderTab, FolderTabs } from "@/components/ui/folder"

<Folder defaultValue="inbox">
  <FolderTabs aria-label="Mail">
    <FolderTab value="inbox">Inbox</FolderTab>
    <FolderTab value="drafts">Drafts</FolderTab>
  </FolderTabs>
  <FolderContent value="inbox">Three letters are waiting.</FolderContent>
  <FolderContent value="drafts">Two drafts.</FolderContent>
</Folder>
